working_definition: Mechanosensory sensory neurons of the adult haltere (FCA haltere); authors gave no FBbt term (Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any adult neuron that is capable of some detection of mechanical stimulus that is part of sensory perception.

justification: FBbt has only sensory neuron of haltere campaniform sensillum / capitellum trichoid sensillum subtypes, which do not cover all haltere mechanosensory neurons; adult mechanosensory neuron is the common parent.

other_candidates.fbbt_term: sensory neuron of haltere campaniform sensillum
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Sensory neuron that has a dendrite in a campaniform sensillum of the haltere.

other_candidates.fbbt_term: sensory neuron of haltere capitellum trichoid sensillum
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Sensory neuron that has a dendrite in a capitellum trichoid sensillum.

recommendation: Use adult mechanosensory neuron (FBbt:00051420) as a broad match.
